correctness.rationale: The deck reconstruction identities give equivalence with four exact integer invariants. Solving three linear constraints forces gap difference (-t,3t,-3t,t), and the fourth yields t(b-c+3t)=0, hence at most one distinct partner. Its nonnegativity and the b<c orientation give a bijection of doubletons with (t>=1,u,b,d>=0), and the GF follows by an exact product. The included verifier groups literal length-three subsequence vectors for 3,876 words through z=15 and checks all classes. No infinite conclusion rests on enumeration.

originality.rationale: Earlier work already establishes finite-word binomial equivalence, compression of arbitrary binary three-decks to four parameters, global tabulated counts and length-seven first collisions. The novel claim is instead the complete nonnegative integer fiber structure and exact all-length fixed-three-one class-count series. Targeted research-index and primary-source comparisons found no stronger statement implying it; see explicit residual source-access risk.
residual_risks: General low-level deck parameterization is known and is explicitly excluded from novelty; only exact fixed-weight-three fibers/count are asserted as new.

value.rationale: Exact 3-deck reconstruction at prescribed Hamming weight three is a natural substantive boundary beyond weight <=2 and known length-seven collisions. The theorem supplies an infinite nontrivial class classification, a maximum ambiguity multiplicity of two, and exact rational counts at every blocklength, directly resolving a fixed-weight deck-invariant question; no generic deck compression or recomputation of short known tables is presented as its value.
